articles.headline: Braves punch playoff ticket as Harris, Acuña and Olson launch 2-run homers in 6-2 win over Astros
articles.description: — Michael Harris II, Ronald Acuña Jr. and Matt Olson each hit a two-run homer as the Atlanta Braves clinched a playoff berth with a 6-2 victory over the Houston Astros on Friday night.
articles.headlineJa: ブレーブスがアストロズに6-2で勝利、ハリス、アクーニャ、オルソンの2ラン本塁打でプレーオフ進出を決める
articles.descriptionJa: アトランタ・ブレーブスは金曜日の夜、マイケル・ハリス2世、ロナルド・アクーニャJr.、マット・オルソンがそれぞれ2ラン本塁打を放ち、ヒューストン・アストロズに6-2で勝利してプレーオフ進出を確定させました。
articles.body:
HOUSTON -- — Michael Harris II, Ronald Acuña Jr. and Matt Olson each hit a two-run homer as the Atlanta Braves clinched a playoff berth with a 6-2 victory over the Houston Astros on Friday night.


              The Braves secured at least a National League wild card and reduced their magic number to three for winning the NL East. Atlanta is heading to the postseason for the eighth time in nine years.


              The loss dropped Houston's lead in the AL West over Texas to a half-game game, with the Rangers hosting Toronto on Friday night. 


              Olson hit his 40th home run in the ninth inning to make him the fifth player in franchise history with multiple 40-homer seasons after he set a Braves record with 54 in 2023. 


              Harris, who had three hits, gave the Braves a 2-0 lead with his homer off Peter Lambert (8-10) in the fourth. They were clinging to a one-run lead with one on and one out in the seventh when Acuña connected off Bennett Sousa to make it 4-1.


              The Astros had runners on first and second with two outs in the eighth when an RBI single by Isaac Paredes cut the lead to 4-2. Jose Altuve hit a flyball to shallow right field but Acuña made a diving catch to end the inning. 


              Tyler Mahle (7-10) allowed three hits and a run with six strikeouts in six innings to help the Braves to their second win in five games.


              Lambert yielded six hits and two runs in 5 1/3 innings. He remained winless since July 11.


              Olson singled with one out in the fourth before Harris put the Braves on top with his shot to the seats in left field.


              Yordan Alvarez got Houston’s first hit on a double with no outs in the fourth. The Astros cut the lead to one when he scored on a single by Paredes.


              Houston had runners at first and third with one out in the inning, but Mahle retired Christian Walker on a flyout to shallow center and Taylor Trammell on a groundout to escape the jam.


              Up next
              Atlanta RHP Grant Holmes (9-5, 3.49 ERA) opposes RHP Hayden Wesneski (5-2, 3.70) when the series continues Saturday night.


              ------


              
                See AP’s full MLB coverage here
articles.bodyJa:
ヒューストン -- 金曜日の夜、アトランタ・ブレーブスはマイケル・ハリス2世、ロナルド・アクーニャJr.、マット・オルソンがそれぞれ2ランホームランを放ち、6-2でヒューストン・アストロズに勝利してプレーオフ進出を決めた。

ブレーブスは少なくともナショナル・リーグのワイルドカード枠を確保し、NL東地区優勝へのマジックナンバーを3に減らした。アトランタがポストシーズンに進出するのは過去9年間で8度目となる。

この敗戦により、アストロズのAL西地区首位でのテキサス・レンジャーズに対するリードは半ゲーム差に縮まった。レンジャーズは金曜日の夜にトロント・ブルージェイズをホームに迎えている。

オルソンは9回に第40号ホームランを放ち、2023年に球団記録の54本を放ったのに続き、ブレーブス史上5人目となる複数回の40本塁打シーズン達成者となった。

3安打を記録したハリスは、4回にピーター・ランバート（8勝10敗）からホームランを放ち、ブレーブスに2-0のリードをもたらした。1点リードで迎えた7回1死一塁の場面で、アクーニャがベネット・スーサから叩き込み、4-1と突き放した。

アストロズは8回2死一、二塁からアイザック・パレデスのタイムリーヒットで4-2と追い上げた。ホセ・アルトゥーベが浅い右飛を打ったが、アクーニャがダイビングキャッチを見せてピンチを脱した。

タイラー・マーリー（7勝10敗）は6回を3安打1失点6奪球に抑え、ブレーブスに過去5試合で2勝目をもたらした。

ランバートは5回1/3を投げ6安打2失点。7月11日以来勝利から遠ざかっている。

オルソンは4回1死からシングルヒットを放ち、続いてハリスが左翼席への一発でブレーブスが先制した。

ヨルダン・アルバレスが4回無死から二塁打を放ち、ヒューストンのチーム初安打となった。続くパレデスのタイムリーヒットでアストロズが1点差に迫った。

アストロズはこの回1死一、三塁の好機を作ったが、マーリーはクリスチャン・ウォーカーを浅い中飛、テイラー・トラメルをゴロに打ち取ってピンチを切り抜けた。

次回対戦
シリーズが土曜日の夜に続く中、アトランタの右腕グラント・ホームズ（9勝5敗、防御率3.49）と右腕ヘイデン・ウェスネスキ（5勝2敗、防御率3.70）が対戦する。

------

articles.headline: Chourio's homer and Frelick's RBI single in 10th carry Brewers past Orioles 6-5
articles.description: — Jackson Chourio hit a three-run homer, Sal Frelick singled in the go-ahead run in the 10th inning and the surging Milwaukee Brewers beat the Baltimore Orioles 6-5 on Friday night.
articles.headlineJa: チョウリオの本塁打と10回のフレリックのタイムリーでブルワーズがオリオールズを6-5で下す
articles.descriptionJa: ジャクソン・チョウリオが3ラン本塁打を放ち、ソル・フレリックが10回に勝ち越しタイムリーヒットを打って、好調のミルウォーキー・ブルワーズが金曜日の夜にボルチモア・オリオールズを6-5で破りました。
articles.body:
BALTIMORE -- — Jackson Chourio hit a three-run homer, Sal Frelick singled in the go-ahead run in the 10th inning and the surging Milwaukee Brewers beat the Baltimore Orioles 6-5 on Friday night.


              Although the Brewers own the best record in the majors (96-58) and have already clinched their fourth straight NL Central title, they aren't coasting to the finish. Milwaukee is still looking to wrap up a first-round bye in the playoffs and earn home-field advantage throughout the postseason.


              “We're trying to win games and keep everybody healthy,” manager Pat Murphy said before the game.


              The Brewers got their eighth victory in 10 games despite blowing a two-run lead in the ninth. After William Contreras hit a tiebreaking double and Christian Yelich tacked on a run-scoring single in the top half, Baltimore pulled even in the bottom half against Trevor Megill (3-3) with two hits and a pair of sacrifice flies.


              In the 10th, automatic runner Joey Ortiz advanced on a bunt and trotted home when Frelick bounced a single to right field off Grant Wolfram (6-4).


              Chad Patrick got three outs for his sixth save.


              Like Milwaukee, the Orioles (75-79) are also in a playoff race. But Baltimore is running out of time in its bid to claim the final AL wild-card spot. 


              Chourio put Milwaukee up 3-0 in the second inning with a shot to center off Cade Povich. Pete Alonso answered in the third with his 38th homer following an infield single and a walk. 


              Alonso has homered in three straight games, beginning with a ninth-inning, game-tying drive Tuesday night against his former team, the New York Mets.


              Brewers starter Dustin May gave up three runs and six hits before being yanked with one out in the third. In eight starts since coming to Milwaukee in an Aug. 3 trade with St. Louis, the right-hander is 2-2 with a 5.40 ERA.


              Up next
              Milwaukee left-hander Robert Gasser (4-5, 4.30 ERA) faces the Orioles and lefty Trevor Rogers (10-10, 4.22) on Saturday afternoon. 


              ------


              
                See AP’s full MLB coverage here
articles.bodyJa:
ボルティモア -- 金曜日の夜、ジャクソン・チョウリオが3ランホームランを放ち、サル・フレリックが10回に勝ち越しのタイムリーヒットを放ち、勢いに乗るミルウォーキー・ブルワーズが6-5でボルティモア・オリオールズを下した。

ブルワーズはメジャー最高の成績（96勝58敗）を誇り、すでにNL中地区4連覇を決めているが、消化試合にするつもりはない。ミルウォーキーは依然としてポストシーズンでの第1ラウンド免除（バイ）と全日程でのホームアドバンテージ確保を目指している。

「我々は試合に勝ち、全員の健康を維持しようとしている」と、パット・マーフィー監督は試合前に語った。

ブルワーズは9回に2点リードを追いつかれたものの、過去10試合で8勝目を挙げた。表の攻撃でウィリアム・コントレラスが勝ち越し二塁打を放ち、クリスチャン・イエリッチがタイムリーで追加点を挙げたが、ボルティモアは裏の攻撃でトレバー・ミギル（3勝3敗）から2安打と2本の犠牲フライで同点に追いついた。

10回、タイブレークのランナー ジョーイ・オルティスがバントで進塁し、フレリックがグラント・ウルフラム（6勝4敗）からライトへ転がるタイムリーを放つと、ホームへ生還した。

チャド・パトリックが3つのアウトを取って今季6セーブ目を挙げた。

ミルウォーキー同様、オリオールズ（75勝79敗）もプレーオフ争いの真っ只中にいる。しかし、ボルティモアはALワイルドカードの最後の1枠を獲得するための時間が残り少なくなっている。

チョウリオは2回、ケイド・ポビッチからセンターへ叩き込み、ミルウォーキーに3-0のリードをもたらした。ピート・アロンソは3回、内野安打と四球の後に第38号ホームランを放って反撃した。

アロンソは火曜日の夜に古巣ニューヨーク・メッツ戦で9回に同点弾を放って以来、3試合連続でホームランを記録している。

ブルワーズの先発ダスティン・メイは3回1死で降板するまでに3失点6安打を許した。8月3日にセントルイスからのトレードでミルウォーキーに加入して以来、この右腕は8試合の先発で2勝2敗、防御率5.40となっている。

次回対戦
土曜日の午後はミルウォーキーの左腕ロバート・ガサー（4勝5敗、防御率4.30）とオリオールズの左腕トレバー・ロジャース（10勝10敗、防御率4.22）が対戦する。

------

articles.headline: Fantasy football Week 2 inactives: Collins ruled out, Flowers Doubtful, Burrow Questionable for Sunday
articles.description: Updated inactives and analysis based on the latest reports and official announcements leading up to kickoff.
articles.headlineJa: ファンタジーフットボール第2週欠場情報：コリンズは欠場、フラワーズは厳しい状況、バロウは日曜出場の可能性五分五分
articles.descriptionJa: キックオフに向けた最新レポートと公式発表に基づく最新の欠場選手情報と分析。
articles.body:
Whom should you start? Whom should you sit? To help you set your fantasy football lineups and avoid starting an offensive player who won't be in the lineup, we'll post fantasy-relevant updates and analysis here as NFL teams release their official inactives lists. 

Official Sunday inactives should begin coming in approximately 90 minutes before the scheduled kickoff times: around 11:30 a.m. ET for the early games and 2:30 p.m. ET for the late-afternoon games.

Refresh often for the latest information.

Don't forget to check these out: Mike Clay's Playbook | Week 2 Buzz 

Week 2 Rankings | Matchup rankings for Week 2

Biggest concerns heading into Week 2

Players with early starts

Zay Flowers, WR, Ravens (hamstring): Flowers was on his way to a monstrous Week 1 performance when he exited because of a hamstring injury that caused him to miss the first two days of practice this week. He did return to the field Friday, giving him a chance to suit up in Week 2. However, he is officially doubtful to go. If Flowers were to suit up this week, there is added risk that he could once again exit early.

If he sits, Rashod Bateman would be the No. 1 WR option for Lamar Jackson and would bring upside for fantasy, even if the floor is low. Mark Andrews should be started as a TE1. Some streaming options this week include Jalen Coker, Caleb Douglas, Devaughn Vele, plus a sleeper for this week, DeMario Douglas.

Joe Burrow, QB, Bengals (back): Burrow is dealing with back soreness and is listed as questionable but is expected to start. The quarterback stated that it would be "ridiculous" if the injury caused him to miss Week 2. Even in a tough matchup like the Texans, Burrow is a fantasy QB1.

If you want to avoid the matchup, Jaxson Dart and Brock Purdy are realistic options that a fantasy manager could have backing up Burrow. If you're skittish, those two could be started over him. However, for most of you, the choice should be to ride with Burrow.

TreVeyon Henderson, RB, Patriots (ankle): After missing the Patriots' opener because of an ankle injury, Henderson returned to practice this week and says he is "ready to go" for Week 2. Henderson will share work in the backfield with Rhamondre Stevenson. However, he is the more explosive option and therefore brings more fantasy upside.

Henderson can be played over Quinshon Judkins, MarShawn Lloyd, Tony Pollard, J.K. Dobbins, Rico Dowdle, Blake Corum, Kenny Gainwell and Jonathon Brooks.

Jalen Coker, WR, Panthers (ankle): After a huge Week 1 performance, Coker was limited in practice to start the week because of an ankle injury. He was able to log a full practice Friday and was removed from the injury report, meaning he will play in Week 2. While the Panthers will not often have "scorefests" like they did in Week 1, Coker's usage jumps off the screen. He saw nine targets -- three of the deep variety -- and finished with 138 yards and a touchdown, while narrowly missing a second score.

Coker is a high upside WR3. Yo
articles.bodyJa:
誰をスタート（起用）させるべきか？誰をシット（ベンチ待機）させるべきか？ファンタジーフットボールのラインナップを組み、出場しない攻撃選手を誤って起用するのを防ぐため、NFLチームが公式の非アクティブリスト（不参加者リスト）を発表し次第、ファンタジーに関連する最新情報と分析をここでお届けします。

日曜日の公式非アクティブリストは、予定されているキックオフ時間の約90分前から順次届く予定です。早めの試合は東部時間午前11:30頃、午後の遅い試合は東部時間午後2:30頃となります。

最新情報を取得するために頻繁に更新してください。

こちらもチェックをお忘れなく: マイク・クライのプレイブック | 第2週の話題

第2週ランキング | 第2週のマッチアップランキング

第2週に向けた最大の懸念事項

早い時間帯に試合がある選手たち

ゼイ・フラワーズ、WR、レイブンズ（ハムストリング）：フラワーズは第1週で凄まじいパフォーマンスを見せていたところでハムストリングの負傷により途中退場し、今週の練習最初の2日間を欠席しました。しかし、金曜日にはグラウンドに戻り、第2週に出場するチャンスを残しました。ただし、公式の出場ステータスは「Doubtful（出場疑問）」となっています。もし今週出場したとしても、再び早期退場するリスクが残ります。

もし彼が欠場した場合、ラマー・ジャクソンにとってラショッド・ベイトマンが第1WRの選択肢となり、フロア（最低保障点）は低いもののファンタジー上のアップサイド（上振れ期待）をもたらすでしょう。マーク・アンドリュースはTE1としてスタート起用すべきです。今週のストリーミング（スポット起用）候補には、ジェイレン・コーカー、カレブ・ダグラス、デヴォン・ヴェール、そして今週のスリーパーであるデマリオ・ダグラスが挙げられます。

ジョー・バロウ、QB、ベンガルズ（背中）：バロウは背中の痛みを抱えており「Questionable（出場不透明）」にリストされていますが、先発出場が見込まれています。このクォーターバックは、負傷が原因で第2週を欠場することになれば「馬鹿げている」と語っています。テキサンズのような厳しいカードであっても、バロウはファンタジーにおけるQB1です。

対戦カードを避けたい場合、ジャクソン・ダートやブロック・パーディはバロウの控えとして現実的な選択肢となります。不安があるなら、その2人をバロウより優先して起用してもよいでしょう。しかし、多くのファンタジーマネージャーにとっては、バロウを信じて起用し続けるのが正解です。

トレベヨン・ヘンダーソン、RB、ペイトリオッツ（足首）：足首の負傷でペイトリオッツの開幕戦を欠場した後、ヘンダーソンは今週練習に復帰し、第2週に向けて「準備完了」と語っています。ヘンダーソンはラモンドレ・スティーブンソンとバックフィールドの出番を分け合うことになります。しかし、彼はより爆発力のある選択肢であり、したがってファンタジーでのより高いアップサイドをもたらします。

ヘンダーソンは、クインショーン・ジャドキンス、マーショーン・ロイド、トニー・ポラード、J.K.ドビンス、リコ・ダドル、ブレイク・コーラム、ケニー・ゲインウェル、ジョナサン・ブルックスよりも優先して起用できます。

ジェイレン・コーカー、WR、パンサーズ（足首）：第1週で素晴らしいパフォーマンスを見せた後、コーカーは足首の負傷により週前半の練習が制限されました。しかし金曜日にはフル練習をこなし、負傷レポートから外れたため、第2週に出場することになります。パンサーズが第1週のようなハイスコアゲームを頻繁に行うことはないでしょうが、コーカーの起用データは突出しています。ターゲット9回（うちディープターゲット3回）を受け、138ヤード、1タッチダウンを記録し、2つ目のタッチダウンにもあと一歩でした。

コーカーは高いアップサイドを持つWR3です。Yo

articles.headline: Juan Soto's homer leads Mets to 6-3 win that keeps Phillies from taking over top NL wild-card spot
articles.description: — Juan Soto hit a three-run homer and the New York Mets kept the Philadelphia Phillies from gaining ground in the National League wild-card race with a 6-3 victory Friday night.
articles.headlineJa: フアン・ソトの本塁打でメッツが6-3で勝利、フィリーズのナ・リーグワイルドカード首位奪取を阻む
articles.descriptionJa: フアン・ソトが3ラン本塁打を放ち、ニューヨーク・メッツが金曜日の夜に6-3で勝利したことで、ナショナル・リーグのワイルドカード争いにおいてフィラデルフィア・フィリーズの猛追を食い止めました。
articles.body:
NEW YORK -- — Juan Soto hit a three-run homer and the New York Mets kept the Philadelphia Phillies from gaining ground in the National League wild-card race with a 6-3 victory Friday night.


              Edmundo Sosa went 3 for 3 with a home run and a double for the Phillies (85-69), who remained tied with the Cubs for the top two wild-card spots after Chicago lost 6-4 to Cincinnati. Both teams began the day one game ahead of the San Diego Padres, who were scheduled to host Miami later Friday.


              Derek Hill also went deep and Bryson Stott had an RBI double for Philadelphia.


              Soto also doubled and finished with three hits. A.J. Ewing’s two-run single capped a three-run first inning for the last-place Mets, who ended a five-game losing streak — their longest under interim manager Andy Green. Carson Benge had an RBI single in the first and reached base three times.


              Francisco Lindor remained at 299 career homers after going 2 for 5 with a double.


              Rookie left-hander Zac Thornton (5-5) allowed two runs and five hits in six innings. He struck out four and walked one. Thornton has permitted two runs or fewer eight times in 14 big league starts.


              Dedniel Núñez got four outs for his second career save and first since July 13, 2024.


              José Urquidy tossed 4 2/3 innings of scoreless bulk relief in his Phillies debut. Urquidy, designated for assignment by the Chicago White Sox on Tuesday, was claimed off waivers Thursday.


              Phillies opener Tim Mayza (3-4) was charged with three runs. He threw 33 pitches but recorded just one out — the shortest outing by a Philadelphia starter since Cristopher Sánchez got only one out against the Washington Nationals on July 29, 2021.


              Up next
              The Mets will retire the No. 15 jersey worn by Hall of Fame center fielder Carlos Beltrán on Saturday before RHP Christian Scott (4-5, 3.76 ERA) opposes Phillies RHP Andrew Painter (3-9, 5.54).


              ------


              
                See AP’s full MLB coverage here
articles.bodyJa:
ニューヨーク -- 金曜日の夜、フアン・ソトが3ランホームランを放ち、ニューヨーク・メッツが6-3でフィラデルフィア・フィリーズを下し、フィリーズがナショナル・リーグのワイルドカード争いで差を詰めるのを阻止した。

エドムンド・ソサは、シカゴ・カブスがシンシナティ・レッズに6-4で敗れた後もカブスと並んでワイルドカードの上位2枠をキープしているフィリーズ（85勝79敗）相手に、ホームランと二塁打を含む3打数3安打を記録した。両チームはこの日を、金曜日遅くにマイアミをホームに迎える予定だったサンディエゴ・パドレスに1ゲーム差をつけて迎えていた。

フィラデルフィアではデレク・ヒルも本塁打を放ち、ブライソン・ストットがタイムリー二塁打を記録した。

ソトは二塁打も放ち、3安打で終えた。A.J.ユーイングの2点タイムリーが、最下位メッツの初回3得点の猛攻を締めくくった。メッツはアンディ・グリーン監督代行のもとで最長となる5連敗を止めた。カーソン・ベンジは初回にタイムリーヒットを放ち、3度出塁した。

フランシスコ・リンドーアは5打数2安打1二塁打を記録したものの、キャリア通算299本塁打にとどまった。

ルーキー左腕のザック・ソーントン（5勝5敗）は6回を投げ、5安打2失点に抑えた。4奪三振、1四球を記録。ソーントンはメジャーでの先発14試合中8試合で2失点以下に抑えている。

デドニエル・ヌニェスは4つのアウトを取り、キャリア2セーブ目（2024年7月13日以来）を挙げた。

ホセ・ウルキディはフィリーズデビュー戦でバルクリリーフとして4回2/3を無失点に抑えた。ウルキディは火曜日にシカゴ・ホワイトソックスからDFA（枠開け手続き）となり、木曜日にウェーバー経由で獲得されていた。

フィリーズのオープナーを務めたティム・メイザ（3勝4敗）は3失点を喫した。33球を投げたものの1アウトしか取れず、これはフィラデルフィアの先発投手としては2021年7月29日にクリストファー・サンチェスがワシントン・ナショナルズ戦で1アウトしか取れなかった時以来、最短の登板となった。

次回対戦
メッツは土曜日、野球殿堂入りを果たした中堅手カルロス・ベルトランが着用していた背番号15の永久欠番式典を行う。その後、右腕クリスチャン・スコット（4勝5敗、防御率3.76）がフィリーズの右腕アンドリュー・ペインター（3勝9敗、防御率5.54）と対戦する。

articles.headline: Red Sox beat Rays 4-2 to close in on playoff spot
articles.description: — Roman Anthony homered and drove in three runs and the Boston Red Sox took a big step toward clinching an American League playoff spot with a 4-2 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays on Friday night.
articles.headlineJa: レッドソックスがレイズを4-2で破りプレーオフ進出に前進
articles.descriptionJa: ローマン・アンソニーが本塁打を放つなど3打点を挙げ、ボストン・レッドソックスは金曜日の夜にタンパベイ・レイズに4-2で勝利し、アメリカン・リーグのプレーオフ進出決定に向けて大きく前進しました。
articles.body:
ST. PETERSBURG, Fla. -- — Roman Anthony homered and drove in three runs and the Boston Red Sox took a big step toward clinching an American League playoff spot with a 4-2 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays on Friday night.


              The Red Sox, who entered Friday with a magic number of three, could secure a wild-card spot as early as Saturday.


              Junior Caminero and Jonathan Aranda drove in runs for the postseason-bound Rays. They had won six in a row.


              Anthony hit the game’s third pitch from Ian Seymour (9-7) into the right-field seats for his third career leadoff homer. Then, in the second inning, Anthony broke a 1-1 tie and drove in two more runs with a two-out single.


              Jahmai Jones gave Boston a 4-1 advantage with his own solo homer to lead off the third. Caleb Durbin added two hits for the Red Sox, who own the American League’s third-best record (84-70), behind the Rays and Yankees.


              Red Sox starter Ranger Suarez (8-4) threw 5 2/3 innings, allowing three hits and one run with five walks and five strikeouts. He also snared Taylor Walls’ 100-mph liner in the fourth, before completing an inning-ending double play.


              Tampa Bay couldn’t capitalize on multiple opportunities, including nine Red Sox walks. The Rays left the bases loaded in the sixth and ninth, when Erik Miller retired Chandler Simpson on a game-ending grounder. Tampa Bay was 0 for 13 with runners in scoring position.


              Boston left-hander Erik Miller had his fifth save despite a shaky ninth inning, including three wild pitches and two walks.


              Up next
              Tampa Bay RHP Freddy Peralta (9-11, 4.67 ERA) was set to start Saturday. Boston had yet to announce a starter.


              ------

articles.headline: Source: Former Mexico boss Aguirre close to taking over struggling Valencia
articles.description: Former Mexico boss Javier Aguirre has emerged as the leading candidate to fill Valencia's coaching vacancy, a source told ESPN.
articles.headlineJa: 情報筋：前メキシコ代表監督のアギーレ氏、低迷するバレンシアの監督就任に接近
articles.descriptionJa: 前メキシコ代表監督のハビエル・アギーレ氏が、バレンシアの監督空席を埋める最有力候補として浮上していると関係者がESPNに語りました。
articles.body:
Valencia has stepped up talks with Javier Aguirre for their vacant coaching job, and a formal offer is expected to be made to the former Mexico boss in the coming days, a source told ESPN's Rodra.

The LaLiga side sacked Carlos Corberán last Sunday and immediately appointed Braulio Vázquez as sporting director to lead the search for a new coach.

Vázquez has been weighing several options, but a source confirms that Aguirre is currently the frontrunner. Ernesto Valverde was also on Valencia's shortlist, but he declined to manage this season after concluding his tenure with Athletic Club.

Valencia sit in the relegation zone after picking up just four points from their first six games.

Aguirre, 67, guided Mexico to the Round of 16 at the last World Cup before they were eliminated by England at the Azteca Stadium. After he finished his deal with Mexico -- a national team he managed across three separate spells, including the 2002 World Cup -- his assistant and 'El Tri' legend, Rafael Márquez, took over as head coach.

He has already fielded approaches from other teams, but the prospect of returning to LaLiga is his preferred option, a source added.

'El Vasco' boasts an extensive career in the Spanish league, with managerial stints at Atlético Madrid, Osasuna, Espanyol, Zaragoza, Leganés, and Mallorca.

Aguirre's potential appointment would be warmly welcomed by the Valencia squad, who view him as a manager with proven experience in lifting teams out of relegation battles, sources closed to the team said.

The NBA offseason is here, and teams across the league have been busy making moves. Free agency officially began June 30.

I'm grading every free agent signing and the most impactful extensions this offseason, breaking down the ramifications for all teams and players involved.

To determine each grade, I'm looking at multiple factors, including the player's on-court impact and age, the contract's financial implications and the context of the team's short- and long-term outlooks. How risky or certain is the move? And how much does it help or hurt the team's chance to win a championship, next season or beyond?

Let's get into the latest moves:

Sept. 18: Heat give Larsson a new deal

Pelle Larsson terms: Four years, $60 million, with a mutual option in the fourth year

Grade: B

At summer league in Las Vegas this year, I had a conversation with various NBA folks about the Miami Heat. We were talking about the Heat's lineup possibilities around Giannis Antetokounmpo and how they might build a winner with depleted depth. One clear conclusion from this conversation was that Pelle Larsson was going to get a lot of minutes because Heat coach Erik Spoelstra adores him.

The 25-year-old Swedish guard was a steal at the No. 44 pick in the 2024 draft, and he took a big step forward last season, averaging 11.4 points, 3.5 rebounds and 3.4 assists. The Heat also trust him as a lead defender on the perimeter. He ranked fourth on the team in starts and fifth in total minutes last season.

Larsson profiles as a high-floor, low-ceiling player, given his age and skill set. Most prominently, a shaky 3-point shot (33% in his career) means he's not truly a 3-and-D player but rather a jack of all trades who fits the Heat's preferred ethos with his hustle and stamina.

Still, that high floor means a $15 million average for Larsson is a reasonable value for Miami, and this new deal will carry him through most of his prime years. Larsson must be happy with his new deal, given that his rookie contract was worth only $5.4 million over three years. Spoelstra must be happy to lock up one of his favorite players for the long term, too.

Sept. 18: George, Jazz agree to extension

Keyonte George terms: Five years, $157.5 million

Grade: C+

George was one of the breakout players of the 2025-26 season, averaging 23.6 points and 6.1 assists while making 37% of his 3-pointers. He also boosted his efficiency from 7-8% below average in his first two seasons to 5% above average last year, which made him one of the top offensive guards in the sport.

On its own, that trajectory -- combined with George's age, as he'll turn 23 in November -- makes him more than worthy of this new rookie extension, which will pay him an average of $31.5 million per year. articles.body:
NBA free agency has almost reached the end, with several players landing in new homes this offseason.

LeBron James decided to continue his historic career with the Philadelphia 76ers after months of deliberation. The Sixers also traded for Jaylen Brown this summer, turning the franchise into a true contender with two huge moves.

Meanwhile, Giannis Antetokounmpo is headed to South Beach to team up with Bam Adebayo and the Miami Heat, and the Los Angeles Lakers have been sold for the second time in 10 months.

What will happen next during this turbulent offseason?

Check back here for all the latest buzz, news and reactions from our ESPN NBA insiders, with the latest info at the top:

Sept. 18

Pistons, Thompson reach five-year, $155 million extension

Detroit Pistons All-Defensive forward Ausar Thompson has agreed to a five-year, $155 million rookie-scale contract extension with the franchise, sources told ESPN.

Thompson lands the fully guaranteed extension after making first-team All-Defense and finishing third in Defensive Player of the Year voting last season. The 23-year-old averaged 9.9 points, 5.7 rebounds, 3.1 assists and 0.9 blocks in 2025-26 while leading the NBA in steals per game (2.0).

Heat, Larsson agree to four-year, $60 million extension

Miami Heat guard Pelle Larsson has agreed to a new four-year, $60 million contract extension, with a mutual option for the 2030-31 season, Austin Brown and Steven Heumann of CAA Sports told ESPN on Friday.

A second-round find in the 2024 draft, the 6-foot-5 guard avoids restricted free agency next summer and locks in a new deal with a mutual option that fully guarantees $60 million while allowing either side to opt in on 2030.

Jazz, George agree on a five-year, rookie-scale extension

Utah Jazz guard Keyonte George have agreed on a five-year, $157.5 million rookie-scale contract extension with the franchise, sources told ESPN's Shams Charania and Tim MacMahon. George was the No. 16 pick in the 2023 draft and has averaged 17.2 points and 5.3 assists per game in his three seasons with the Jazz.

Sept. 17

Bey, Pelicans agree to three-year extension

New Orleans Pelicans' Saddiq Bey agreed to a three-year, $55.5 million contract extension with the franchise, plus a trade kicker, sources told ESPN's Shams Charania. Bey averaged a career-high 17.7 points per game last season after missing all of the 2024-25 season with a torn ACL.

Sept. 16

Kings remain interested in Duren

The Sacramento Kings continue to loom in the background of Jalen Duren's restricted free agency with the incumbent Detroit Pistons.

Kings general manager Scott Perry met with Duren for dinner in Miami in early July and has maintained a level of steady interest in the ultimate outcome of Duren's free agency, though a path to acquire Duren this summer remains blocked.
